w2-01-doesn-t-move-me: She mentions some guy who texted her… and watches your face. 👀
She's not trying to hurt you. She's checking if you'll shake. Don't compete with guys you can't even see.
w2-03-your-plans-matter: You dropped your plans for her again, didn't you?
When you drop everything every time, your time stops meaning anything. Your plans matter.
w2-04-not-a-free-service: Nice guys don't finish last. Always-available guys do.
Stay reliable. Just stop being instant. Be a good man, not a free service.
w2-05-you-almost-had-me: She called you boring. And then you started defending yourself.
She wasn't judging you. She was checking if you'd panic. Stop explaining yourself.
w2-07-not-every-second: Stop sending her "good morning" every single day. Seriously.
When you're always there, she never has to wonder about you. Be there for her, just not every second.
w2-08-be-someone: Agreeing with everything she says is why she's bored of you.
When you agree with everything, there's nobody there. Have your own opinions.
w2-09-respect-her-no: She's flirting all night, then says "not tonight." Here's what that means.
She's not rejecting you. She's protecting herself. Respect her no. That's what a real man does.
w2-10-take-it-offline: If your chats die after "what are you up to?", this is why.
Questions like that feel like work. Say something about her instead. Then ask her out.
w2-11-40-minutes-late: She's forty minutes late, and you said "no problem"?
Being nice isn't the same as having no standards. If you don't respect your own time, nobody will.
w2-13-the-one-text: She said she's busy. Again. Here's the one text to send. (Part 2)
Ask once. If she dodges, send one text and stop. Your energy is for people who show up.
w2-15-notice-dont-flatter: You tell her she's beautiful every time. That's the problem.
Anyone can say she's beautiful. Say something only you would notice. Stop flattering her, start noticing her.
w2-16-just-ask: Flirty on Friday. One-word replies on Sunday. Sound familiar?
Most mixed signals aren't a game. A man asks. A boy guesses.
w2-17-stay-you: She said "cut your hair," and you did it the same week?
Every time you change on command, she learns you can be moved. She liked you for who you were.
